I have taken both my husband and my mother to Abhay Jain at Hi-Tech Eye Care, and every single time, the experience has been outstanding.

What I appreciate most about Abhay is that he never makes you feel like just another customer. He makes you feel genuinely attended to and cared for.

My mother is a senior citizen and can be quite particular when it comes to her spectacles. She was confused about what she wanted, had a few concerns even after the purchase, and needed multiple adjustments. But Abhay handled everything with so much patience and warmth. He even sent his team member home more than once to help her, and ensured she was completely satisfied. In fact, he got her spectacles changed as well because he wanted her to be fully convinced before closing the matter.

My husband had also purchased an expensive pair of spectacles from him. Due to an accidental mistake on our end, the frame got damaged while trying to remove some colour stains. Despite that, Abhay helped get the frame replaced, which was truly appreciated.

Apart from being an excellent friend, Abhay is an exceptional service provider. In today’s world, finding someone who genuinely stands behind their product and service is rare, and Abhay does exactly that.

Thank you, Abhay, and the entire team at Hi-Tech Eye Care, for always going the extra mile. Wishing you continued success, many happy customers, and many more years of serving people with the same dedication and care.

It was a pleasant experience visiting Dr. Arti Lakhote’s The Optometry Clinic in Mahim. She made us feel extremely comfortable and gave us great feedback on everything, including the selection of our frames, which was apt and so classy.

At the Optometry clinic, they have an unbelievably wide range of frames where they provide various frame types, materials, and modern designs that suit different tastes and lifestyles. We absolutely loved their collection and were amazed, as we have never seen so much variety and options under one roof.

The clinic is hygienic and has a friendly and cooperative staff. They have such modern sets of equipment, introducing new techniques for eye checkups.

Dr. Arti is humble, soft-spoken, and made sure to adjust her schedule to give us our preferred time slot.

The Optometry clinic is hands down the best optometric clinic around Mahim and provides the perfect vision health care with a routine comprehensive eye exam.

I would strongly recommend everyone to visit this clinic.

featured_reviews.name: Nilay Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been going to Optometry clinic for a long time , the staff is courteous and provides proper advice on lens and frame.
I have a cylindrical number with some complexity. I never had any issue with my lenses till date

I did try an online lens once in emergency and was a waste of money

My advice to people who have been using spectacles for a long time , go to your optometrist.

Aarti ji is very competent and provides a proper consultation
Totally recommend the clinic

featured_reviews.name: Radha Pagedar
featured_reviews.review_text: I went to get my varifocal glasses from The Optometry clinic. I always get them done here. Mrs Lakhote checks my vision accurately and the glasses are ready in a timely manner. She has a nice selection of frames. The clinic is easily accessible.  The staff are professional and friendly.  They have also accommodated me when I was in a hurry. I would highly recommend the clinic

featured_reviews.name: Madhuri Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional service and care!
Very impressed with my experience at The Optometry Clinic at Mahim, Mumbai; the best in town I must say.
The owner, Arti Lakhote, is very experienced and performs the eye examination a very detailed manner. They have a wide range of frames to select from and helped me find the perfect glasses. She made me feel at ease and not intimidating at all, and offered various options to choose frames from low to high price ranges. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Bhavana Diyora
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely impressed with the professionalism and care at The Optometry Clinic! I came in for an eye exam and progressive lenses, and Arti Lakhote the Owner & super qualified optometrist herself explained everything with such clarity. The staff is courteous, patient-focused, and truly helpful. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality eye care, eye wear and expert guidance.

featured_reviews.name: DrBhavana Diyora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being a doctor, I prefer the knowledgeable and professional service providers. Had a great experience at Arti Lakhote`s The Optometry Clinic!

Arti helped me with the CORRECT glasses and practical solutions for my vision & patiently handled all my queries and doubts. She is highly qualified, knowledgeable, and made me feel comfortable throughout. Also picked up a stylish pair of sunglasses. Excellent service and patient-first approach! I would very strongly recommend The Optometry Clinic

featured_reviews.name: Grow360 Wellness
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was in hurry as I had to travel abroad and with my request Arti put in extra efforts and made my glasses in just 24 hrs!!

THANK YOU ARTI FOR YOUR SUPPRT AND CARE!!

This Optometry Clinic is a perfect place of modern eye care and old-school courtesy. I came in for progressive glasses and also had a thorough eye exam followed by lots of practical tips & advise on eye care & eye wear. The owner Optometrist Arti is very knowledgeable and highly qualified and also very patient in explaining you understand your options. Their customer service is outstanding, especially when helping select frames and sunglasses. A truly patient-focused experience highly recommended for all those in need!!
SHE IS THE BEST!

featured_reviews.name: Varsha chitte
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm thoroughly impressed with Ms. Aarti's expertise and care! 😍☺️ A friend's recommendation led me to her, and I'm so grateful for the referral!💐🙏🏻 As a 34-year-old dealing with rapid myopia progression, I was struggling to find effective solutions. Despite visiting ophthalmologists, I wasn't getting the guidance I needed. Ms. Aarti changed everything! Her extensive experience and patient approach helped her understand my unique situation, including my high myopia (-7/-8) and astigmatism. She took the time to rule out possibilities and provided personalized solutions. I'm now wearing myopia control glasses, and the result is remarkable🤓 Issues like itching and pain have disappeared!😃 Ms. Aarti's calm demeanor, genuine approach, and magnetic personality make her stand out. Highly recommended! 5-star service, exceptional care, and outstanding results. Thank you so much, Ms. Aarti! ❤️🙏🏻🥰
